tools.name: get_menu
tools.description: Detailed saved menu evidence, twelve dietary labels, provenance, freshness and explicit unknowns. Requires a developer API key or a consented OAuth connection in the Authorization header. Each call uses one trial or paid request. Follow pagination even when filtered pages are empty. tools.name: search_places
tools.description: Search restaurants by name. Returns each match with its vegan status, score (0 to 100, 100 = fully vegan), city and page URL.

tools.name: place_vegan_options
tools.description: Free preview of up to four saved dishes at one restaurant. For detailed paginated evidence and all dietary labels use get_menu with a developer key. Pass the slug from a search result URL.

tools.name: places_near
tools.description: Restaurants near a coordinate, nearest first, with status, score and the best dishes of each. Pass needs to require that one dish fits every need (vegan AND gluten-free, not either).

tools.name: city_vegan_places
tools.description: The most diet-friendly places in a city (fully vegan first). Pass needs to require one dish fitting every need. City slugs come from list_cities.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Every city KaleMap covers, with its slug and how many vegan-friendly places it has.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_menu" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
